headlines.title: ‘ 1조 달러 ’ 한국 수출 … 60년간 세계평균 2배 속도로 질주했다
headlines.summary: 대한상의 “연평균 16.6% 성장” ‘1000억→1조 달러’ 31년 걸려 우리나라가 세계에서 네 번째로 연간 1조 달러(약 1341조 원) 시대를 연 가운데, 지난 60여 년간 국내 수출 연평균 증가율은 세계 평균의 2배에 육박했다는 분석 결과가 나왔다.

headlines.title: 기업 체감경기 한 달 만에 꺾여 …내수 기업 은 4년 반 만에 최고
headlines.summary: 기업 체감 경기가 한 달 만에 다시 꺾였습니다. 한국은행이 오늘(25일) 발표한 '11월 기업경기조사 결과'를 보면, 이달 전산업 기업심리지수(CBSI)는 103.5로 지난달보다 0.7포인트 하락했습니다. 지난달 4년여 만에 최고치인 104.2를 기록했지만, 한 달 만에 다시 악화한 겁니다.

headlines.title: “ 뽑아도 2년 못 버틴다 ”… 중소기업 연구인력 2.8만명 감소
headlines.summary: 연구인력 중 중기 비중 54%→46% 중기 신입 연구원 절반 근속 2년 미만 대기업의 연구개발(R&D) 인력은 늘어났으나 중소기업 인력은 통계적으로 유의미하게 줄어든 것으로 집계됐다. 중소기업 연구인력이 전체 기업 인력에서 차지하는 비중도 절반 아래로 떨어졌다. 중소기업에 입사한 연구인력의 50% 가량은 재직기간이 2년 미만인 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 韓 수소차 5만대 선점했지만 … 10만대 고지 중국에 내줄 위기
headlines.summary: 韓 올해 판매량 세계 1위, 점유율 69% 내년 수소차 보급 예산 23%↓, 업계 우려 中 ‘수소굴기 2.0’ 본격화, 1.6조 장려금 “지자체 매칭부담 낮추고 국비지원 확대” 세계 최초로 수소전기차 5만대 보급을 달성한 한국이 10만대 고지는 중국에 내줄 위기에 처했다.

headlines.title: 美 과잉생산 관세 발표 임박 … 韓 ' 15% 상한' 지킬까
headlines.summary: [앵커] 트럼프 미국 행정부가 한국을 비롯한 주요 교역국을 대상으로 이른바 '과잉생산 관세' 부과를 예고했습니다. 기존 한미 무역합의에 따른 15% 관세율이 유지될지 주목되는데요. 우형준 기자, 이르면 오늘(25일) 발표될수도 있다고 하는데, 나왔나요? [기자] 아직입니다.

headlines.title: ‘ 닥공 ’ 발목 잡는 표준건축비 … 정부, 폐지 검토
headlines.summary: 낮은 매입단가에 LH공모사업 부진 국토부, 3년 동결 건축비 현실화나서 원가 반영 부실…개선안 마련도 착수 정부가 2023년 이후 3년 넘게 동결된 공공건설임대주택 표준건축비 현실화에 나선다. 자재비와 인건비 상승에도 표준건축비가 제때 조정되지 않으면서 사업성이 악화하고 주택 공급에도 차질이 빚어지고 있다는 지적에 따른 것이다.

headlines.title: ‘ 햇볕 가뭄 ’에 물가 비상 … 상추 값 121%·깻잎 88% 뛰었다
headlines.summary: ■ 일조량 부족… 채소 도매가 폭등 10~11월 평년比 햇볕 23% 부족 생육 지연에 애호박 184%  올라 김장수요 겹쳐 식재료 비용 부담 정부 2%대 물가관리에 ‘먹구름’ 10월 하순부터 흐린 날씨가 계속되고 일조량이 부족해지면서 채소 도매가격이 급등한 데 이어 소비자가격도 오르며 가계의 밥상 물가 부담이 커지고 있다.

headlines.title: 올해 1 ∼ 9월 태어난 아기 21만9천명 … 증가율 역대 최고
headlines.summary: 작년보다 14.3% 늘어…1981년 통계 집계 이래 최고 3분기 출산율 0.90명…혼인은 11분기 만에 감소 올해 1∼9월 태어난 아기 21만9천명…증가율 역대 최고 (서울=연합뉴스) 류효림 기자 = 올해 들어 3분기까지 태어난 아기가 작년보다 14% 넘게 증가하며 21만명을 넘었다. 증가율은 역대 최고 수준이다.

headlines.title: 10월 국내 이동자 45만3천명 … '반도체 밀집' 충청권 순유입
headlines.summary: 충남·충북 2천276명 순유입…서울 5천560명 순유출 추석 기저효과에 이동자 2.6% 증가…장기 감소세 지속 10월 국내 이동자 45만3천명 (서울=연합뉴스) 김주형 기자 = 지난 8월 30일 서울 영등포구 여의도 63빌딩 전망대에서 바라본 시내 곳곳에 자리 잡은 아파트 전경. 2026.8.

headlines.title: “ 디지털자산법, 지분제한·진입장벽 등 규제 일변도 ”
headlines.summary: ■ 정부안 공개에 기대 반 우려 반 스테이블코인 발행 등은 긍정적 거래소 대주주 지분 20% 한도 신고제 폐지되고 인가·지정제 SK플래닛, 블록체인 서비스 종료 디지털자산 산업 전반을 규율할 디지털자산법 정부안이 베일을 벗은 가운데 25일 업계에서는 환영과 우려의 목소리가 엇갈리고 있다.

headlines.title: 거래소에 ‘ 지분 장벽 ’… 중개 · 운용에 ‘ 새 길 ’
headlines.summary: 판 바뀌는 디지털자산시장 지분 재편 불가피 글로벌 최대 거래소 바이낸스도 규제 사정권 매매업자 유동성 공급, MM 제도권 진입 주목 디지털자산기본법 정부안이 공개되면서 국내 디지털자산 업계의 희비가 엇갈리고 있다.

headlines.title: AI·금리 불확실에 ‘ 증시 멀미주의보 ’
headlines.summary: 사이드카 코스피 62·코스닥 40회 금융위기 2008년 넘은 ‘역대 최다’ 220 거래일 동안 ‘이틀에 한번 꼴’ 최근 미 금리인상·AI 급변동 확대 올해 국내 증시를 관통하는 핵심 키워드는 ‘변동성’이다. 주가 급등락에 따른 충격을 완화하기 위한 사이드카는 올해 들어서만 100차례 넘게 발동됐다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Hits $1 Trillion Annual Export Milestone
key_headlines.summary: South Korea became the world's fourth nation to reach $1 trillion in annual exports, achieving this milestone with average annual export growth of 16.6% over 60 years—nearly double the global average. The country took 31 years to grow from $100 billion to $1 trillion in exports.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Raises Base Rate to 3.25%, Boosts Growth Forecasts
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee raised the benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 3.25% and significantly upgraded economic growth projections to 3.9% for this year and 4.1% for next year. The hike reflects confidence in semiconductor sector recovery outweighing downward pressures, though inflation is expected to remain above target for an extended period.

key_headlines.title: Stock Market Volatility Reaches 23-Year High as Circuit Breakers Trip 62 Times
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market experienced record volatility in 2026, with trading halts triggered 62 times on KOSPI and 40 times on KOSDAQ—exceeding even the 2008 financial crisis frequency. The extreme swings reflect uncertainty surrounding AI developments and U.S. interest rate movements.

key_headlines.title: U.S. Threatens Korea with Up to 25% Tariffs on Semiconductors and Autos
key_headlines.summary: The Trump administration targeted South Korea's semiconductor and automotive support policies as grounds for excess capacity tariffs, initially proposing to maintain the 15% rate from previous trade agreements but potentially raising it to 25% if negotiations fail. This marks a new flashpoint in U.S.-Korea trade relations centered on industrial policy rather than just trade deficits.

key_headlines.title: Vegetable Prices Surge 121% Due to Sunlight Shortage
key_headlines.summary: Insufficient sunlight in October-November caused vegetable wholesale prices to skyrocket, with lettuce rising 121%, perilla leaves 88%, and zucchini 184%. The price surge threatens the government's 2% inflation control target as households face mounting food costs.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea achieved a historic milestone by becoming the world's fourth nation to record $1 trillion in annual exports, demonstrating remarkable growth averaging 16.6% annually—nearly double the global average over six decades. Meanwhile, the domestic economy faces significant challenges as record stock market volatility has triggered circuit breakers 62 times on KOSPI and 40 times on KOSDAQ, surpassing even 2008 financial crisis frequency levels. The stock market turbulence, occurring roughly every two trading days, reflects deep uncertainty surrounding AI sector developments and U.S. monetary policy trajectories. Additionally, severe weather has driven consumer price pressures, with vegetable prices surging dramatically—lettuce up 121%, perilla leaves 88%, and zucchini 184%—threatening price stability targets.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's monetary policy committee raised the base rate by 25 basis points to 3.25%, marking the final rate decision of 2026 amid significant economic recalibrations. The central bank dramatically upgraded growth forecasts to 3.9% for 2026 and 4.1% for 2027, reflecting confidence in semiconductor sector recovery and domestic demand expansion. However, consumer price inflation is projected to remain above the 2% target for an extended period, with the committee noting continued cost pressures from supply-side constraints. The rate increase passed with 5 of 7 votes, while two members dissented in favor of holding steady. Market pricing suggests further potential rate increases to 3.50% by May 2027, with varying scenarios extending to 3.75% or reverting to 3.00%.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean financial markets experienced sharp reversals on November 26, with KOSPI rebounding 2.17% to exceed 4,800 points after previous day losses, while KOSDAQ surged over 3% driven by foreign investor and institutional buying. The rally was partly fueled by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return announcement, which triggered a 31.5% surge in Nvidia's stock price—the largest single-day gain since 2003—and global technology stock recovery. Bond markets showed anticipation for the rate decision, with government bond yields declining across maturities on November 25 as investors repositioned ahead of the monetary policy announcement. Despite the intraday recovery, the broader market remains vulnerable to external shocks, particularly U.S. Federal Reserve policy signals and ongoing AI sector valuation concerns.
sections.Industry & Technology: The government is considering introducing production tax credits for domestically-manufactured electric vehicles, potentially offering up to 4 million won in tax benefits, drawing parallels to past semiconductor industry support measures. The Trump administration has specifically targeted South Korea's semiconductor and automotive industrial policies as evidence of overcapacity, threatening tariffs up to 25% if bilateral negotiations fail to address these concerns. DGIST-affiliated startup ESInnovations is advancing autonomous mobile robot technology with a 7.2 billion won Edge AI sensor and system semiconductor research project. Hyundai Glovis has partnered with the automobile dismantling and recycling association to establish a circular economy framework for electric vehicle battery recycling and resource recovery.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment subscription market shows a dramatic shift toward smaller units, with 80.8% of first-priority applicants choosing properties under 60 square meters in the first nine months of 2026—the highest ratio since 2000. Rising apartment prices have forced home buyers to reduce floor space to manage down payment burdens, fundamentally changing housing demand patterns from the traditional 84 square meter 'national standard' unit. Gangnam's jeonse-to-sale price ratio reached 39.22%, the highest level in 17 months, as reconstruction excess profit recovery requirements suppress sales prices while jeonse rents continue climbing. The Korea Land and Housing Corporation is advocating for a 1.5 million person new city project in provincial areas, arguing that regional development with new 'gravity centers' offers a better solution to Seoul housing affordability than simply increasing housing supply.
sections.International Economy: The Trump administration announced excess capacity tariffs targeting major trading partners, with South Korea facing baseline tariffs at the 15% rate established in previous trade agreements while potentially facing increases to 25% depending on negotiation outcomes. U.S. trade officials specifically cited South Korea's industrial support policies and state bank financing as examples of overcapacity creation without corresponding demand. American indices closed mixed on November 25, with the Dow up 0.33%, S&P 500 down 0.25%, and Nasdaq down 0.62%, reflecting tensions between strong economic data and AI investment sustainability concerns. The Federal Reserve faces mounting pressure as inflation pressures resurface while AI investment returns disappoint, complicating the Fed's dual mandate and threatening institutional independence as fiscal pressures mount.
sections.AI & Economy: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Walsh warned that disappointing AI investment returns could trigger stock value declines, economic slowdown, and significant unemployment increases, highlighting systemic risks from concentrated investment in artificial intelligence. The AI sector faces a credibility crisis as market enthusiasm meets reality—some analysts maintain AI will generate substantial long-term economic benefits across software, finance, healthcare, and manufacturing, while skeptics question whether returns justify current valuations. The prediction market platform Kalshi reduced OpenAI's probability of H1 2027 IPO from 50% to 28%, citing recent underperformance of publicly-listed AI firms like Anthropic and broader sector valuation concerns. The Financial Supervisory Service announced the opening of 64 additional financial data items to accelerate AI-driven fintech and wealth management innovations, expecting improved information access and investor decision-making.
sections.Others: Samsung Asset Management's KODEX 200 Covered Call Active ETF distributed dividends reflecting Samsung Electronics' special dividend payouts to shareholders. Analysis of the AI competitive landscape suggests that despite intense competition between OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, ultimately only three major competitors will likely emerge victorious in the long-term AI race. The U.S. Trade Representative explicitly stated that South Korea is artificially expanding supply without corresponding real demand through its industrial support policies, challenging the government's strategic manufacturing development approach. North Korea is expanding tax collection mechanisms through new business registration requirements—even for bicycle repair shops and home restaurants—and implementing digital payment and receipting systems to broaden fiscal revenue sources amid declining export earnings.
